items.t: Engine stalls at stops or while driving
items.job: Replace electronic throttle body (or airflow sensor)
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,300 for a throttle body. A MAF sensor alone runs about $393–$426 at RepairPal.

items.t: ABS light from failed ABS actuator
items.job: Replace ABS actuator and control unit
items.note: Owners report $1,500 to over $4,000, and long parts waits.
Owners report about $400. Camera recalibration can add to the bill.

items.t: Wanders in crosswinds at highway speed
items.job: Wheel alignment and front suspension check
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $171–$251 for an alignment.

items.t: Pulls to one side and wears tires
items.note: Ask for warranty coverage on a new car. New tires cost extra if they are already worn.
